airllm.execution_model: Hugging Face model skeleton on meta device; forward hooks stream per-module weights from safetensors to accelerator and evict back to meta
airllm.prefetch: ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1) loads next streamed layer while current layer computes
airllm.compression: bitsandbytes 4-bit/8-bit path explicitly calls tensor.cuda(); prefetch+compression is disabled
intel_blockers: default device cuda:0 and CUDA-specific pinning checks
compression path requires bitsandbytes and calls .cuda()
runtime is built around PyTorch/Transformers device semantics, not GGML/Vulkan buffers

key_paths: src/llama-model.cpp: llama_model_base::load_tensors, GPU layer placement, backend-buffer allocation
src/llama-kv-cache.cpp: K/V tensor allocation and quantized KV support
ggml/src/ggml-vulkan/ggml-vulkan.cpp: Vulkan buffers, tensor transfers and graph execution

features.lazy_tensor_rows: present for selected tensors via TENSOR_READ_LAZY; not a generic dense-layer residency scheduler

local_observation.pytorch_xpu: not tested because project venv has no torch installed; no capability claim is made from local PyTorch execution
